findings.claim: Q3 FY2026 營收 $2.477B（去年同期 $1.740B）；Design Automation 表現優於預期，Design IP 回到年增；全年營收指引中點上調至約 $9.715B，CFO 預期 EDA 雙位數成長
findings.source: Synopsys Q3 FY2026 earnings press release (SEC 8-K Ex.99.1)

findings.claim: Q2 FY2026 Design IP 營收 $454.2M，年減 5.8%；Q3 回到年增。全年指引上調 $50M 至 $9.69–9.74B，由 Design Automation（EDA）帶動；非 AI 設計活動近兩季趨穩
findings.source: Futurum Group, Synopsys Q3 FY 2026: AI Design Demand Drives EDA Growth
findings.excerpt: Synopsys raised full-year revenue guidance by $50 million at the midpoint to $9.69 billion-$9.74 billion, driven by Design Automation strength led by EDA.

findings.claim: 管理層表示 AI 變現、自主工作流、IP Factory Two、與 Ansys 聯合方案等新項目預期在 FY2027 貢獻較明顯；未找到 2027 正式量化需求預測
findings.source: Futurum Group, Synopsys Q3 FY 2026 / Q2 FY 2026 coverage

findings.claim: SemiAnalysis EDA primer：CY2025 Synopsys（含 Ansys）營收約 $8B、Cadence $5.30B、Siemens EDA 約 $2.2–2.5B；三大廠合計市佔逾 85%；EDA 年複合成長 13% vs 半導體 R&D 7%
Barchart 引述分析師估計 Cadence 與 Synopsys 各約 30% 市佔
findings.source: Barchart, Cadence spikes post earnings with strong interest in AI products
findings.excerpt: Analysts estimate that Cadence and Synopsys (NASDAQ: SNPS) each hold around 30% market share in this space.

end_markets.note: as_of 為依來源推定的近似日期（SemiAnalysis、Barchart 頁面未顯示確切日期）。EDA 授權定價趨勢未找到直接資料；Software-Infrastructure TAM 共識未單獨查。Design IP 僅有 Q2 金額，Q3 無金額。
